## Description {#details}

<p>Encapsulate information regarding vectorization of a loop and its epilogue.</p>


<p>This information is meant to be updated and used across two stages of epilogue vectorization.</p>


<p>Definition at line 689 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/loopvectorize-cpp">LoopVectorize.cpp</a>.</p>
